##### Project general facts

Lanai Islands is a breathtaking ultra-luxury release of just thirteen private estate homes, born out of water and crafted on land across two exclusive paradise islands. Residences come in two distinctive designs, Edge Estates and Shore Estates, both created by the award-winning architectural firm SAOTA and both taking their inspiration from the surrounding crystalline waters and organic beauty of the natural world. Every buyer enjoys the true luxury of freedom, curating their own home through a choice of facade design, layout, interior scheme and landscape style.

This is an exclusive gated and private community reached by its own bridge access, where estate homes sit in lush landscaped gardens beyond white sandy beaches shaded by palm trees. Modern cantilever architecture, expansive forecourts and backyards, grand double-height entries and spectacular double and triple height internal courtyards create a seamless relationship between the indoors and nature outside. Residents are also treated to private spa pools facing the azure lagoon waters, generous car galleries accommodating up to twelve cars and their own luxury home elevators.

Interiors are the work of multi-award-winning Kelly Hoppen CBE, whose signature style fuses clean lines and neutral tones with an infusion of opulent warmth. Each estate offers a choice between two tailored interior schemes, Monochrome and Vintage Glamour for Edge Estates and Eclectic and Serenity for Shore Estates, so every home feels entirely personal. Finishes are exquisite throughout, from herringbone parquet flooring, refined joinery veneers and accent metal detailing to master bathroom and spa marble, striking show kitchen stone and elegant European kitchens with fully integrated appliances.

##### Location description and benefits

Tilal Al Ghaf is a visionary mixed-use community that redefines modern living in Dubai. Nestled in a prime location, this masterfully planned development seamlessly integrates residential, commercial, and recreational elements to create a vibrant and sustainable neighborhood.

Spread across a vast expanse, Tilal Al Ghaf offers a diverse range of living options, from contemporary villas and townhouses to apartments, providing residents with a choice that suits their lifestyle preferences. The community prioritizes green spaces, parks, and landscaped areas, fostering a connection with nature amidst the urban setting.

Designed with a holistic approach, Tilal Al Ghaf incorporates world-class amenities, including schools, healthcare facilities, shopping destinations, and recreational spaces. The centerpiece of this community is the stunning Lagoon Al Ghaf, a vast artificial lagoon surrounded by a sandy beach, offering residents a unique waterfront experience.
